about: The bounded catalogue of output formats. Each format is one LoRA adapter on top of the cleanup model (docs/decisions/0001). The id is the adapter name, the [Format: id] control tag and the file stem of catalogue/prompts/<id>.md (the teacher prompt that writes the training targets).

cleanup_model.note: Format 'none' = the cleanup model alone, no adapter. Built and trained in github.com/danielrosehill/ASR-Post-Processor-Model, not here.

formats.label: Shopping list
formats.source_note: No shopping-list prompt in Text-Transformation-Prompts-300525; written fresh.

formats.label: To-do list
formats.source_note: Inference of dates and owners removed: only what was said.

formats.label: Casual email
formats.source_note: Kept: friendly greeting, sign-off with first name.

formats.label: Business email
formats.source_note: 'Eliminating unnecessary details' removed: every fact the speaker gave is kept.

formats.label: Blog outline
formats.source_note: Markdown shape fixed (one H1, H2 sections, bullets) so the adapter learns one layout, not several.

formats.label: Calendar entries (JSON)
formats.source_note: No inferred times or attendee emails: unstated fields are null, dates stay as spoken in date_text.
